`synthetic.mencrypt` is a synthetic 4156-byte application package generated
with `km003c-lib/src/firmware/tests.rs::package(4156, &[])`. It has the same
deterministic 0x5a body, test vectors, version 1.9.7 and date 2025.9.1 used by
the library's package tests. It contains no manufacturer firmware and must
never be installed on a device. GUI tests only parse and display it.
